{{Top}}
'''Stickle trees''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] found on the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. The exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] kept a bowl of the tree's bitter fruit in [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|his hut]] at the time of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] first visit to the planet in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
